name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: At Lake Falathim, Raene's Cleansing turns from a search for Teronis into a grim recovery. Raene Wolfrunner sent the night elf sentinel there, and now you must bring back his journal and a glowing gem held by the murlocs before reporting to her in Astranaar.

sections.title: A Fallen Scout
sections.body: Raene Wolfrunner sent you to Lake Falathim to find Teronis, a night elf sentinel. You find him dead beside the water. His belongings include an intact journal, with an account of his assignment and what he found about Ashenvale's strange disturbances.

sections.title: The Glowing Gem
sections.body: Teronis tracked a rare, glowing stone to Lake Falathim, but the lake's aggressive murlocs now hold it. You need to recover the gem and Teronis' journal to continue the work he began.

sections.title: Grief in Astranaar
sections.body: Raene Wolfrunner grieves when you return to Astranaar with news of Teronis. She must arrange a patrol to recover her fallen comrade's body, even as corruption threatens the forest. Raene asks you to take up Teronis' work and rebuild the rod he hoped would slow the furbolg attacks.

faq.answer: Teronis was a night elf scout Raene Wolfrunner sent from Astranaar to investigate Lake Falathim and secure a mystical gem. Hostile wildlife killed him before he could finish his duty.

faq.q: Where is the Glowing Gem found?
faq.answer: Murlocs carry the Glowing Gem in and around Lake Falathim, in northwestern Ashenvale, near where Teronis' body was found.

faq.q: Why is Raene Wolfrunner so focused on this task?
faq.answer: Teronis was Raene's longtime friend, and he believed the rod could slow the furbolg attacks on her people. With furbolgs still raiding Ashenvale, Raene gives his unfinished work urgent attention despite his death.

faq.q: What happens to Teronis' body after this quest?
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner pledges to send a detachment of Sentinels from Astranaar to retrieve Teronis' remains for mourning and traditional night elf funeral rites.

Teronis' Journal records his investigation of Dartol, a human wizard who used druidic magic to try to befriend and control the furbolgs. It also holds his notes on recovering the pieces of Dartol's rod.

faq.q: Does this quest chain continue after turning it in?
faq.answer: Yes. When you bring the gem and journal to Raene Wolfrunner, she asks you to continue Teronis' work and seek the remaining pieces of Dartol's rod.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know the death of a fellow Sentinel at Lake Falathim points to danger creeping toward Kalimdor's ancient sacred groves.
As an Alliance member, you help Raene Wolfrunner and the Sentinels hold Ashenvale's northern approaches from Astranaar.
